propositions: Runtime command parsing and generated syntax must be derived from a single side-effect-free argparse factory, eliminating separate manual or docs-only grammar authorities
Pre-operation help output must deliver byte-current generated package data and canonical overview before operation, config, store, or handler initialization
All visible, hidden, exact, compatibility, and retired command spellings must behave per approved specification including jira-onboard historical form and unknown purge-bridge
Lazy execution must preserve mount, init, argv, confirmation, stream, exit-code, and legacy-output contracts while normalizing safe-help forms
Optional mode and backend capabilities must register as error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures without eager optional imports, checked after mode selection
